inputs.payload: Use your native beam workflow to build and validate a simply supported beam of span 6 m carrying a downward uniformly distributed load of 10 kN/m over the full span. Native draft parameters: lengthM=6, supportType=simply-supported, loadKN=10, loadType=distributed, loadPosition=full-span. For this software smoke test I explicitly authorize the built-in beam template's default section and material; disclose the actual defaults. Execute a linear static analysis with the local OpenSees engine through your native run_analysis tool. Report the observed execution status and numerical results with units, and compare them with the textbook reference Mmax=wL^2/8=45 kN m. If a tool fails, report that failure rather than inventing analysis results. Respond in English.
